xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4259: Show effort everywhere and record it in cost data: Agents rows, issue view, pan status/show, cost ledger, and sessions.json

plan.title: Show effort everywhere and record it in cost data: Agents rows, issue view, pan status/show, cost ledger, and sessions.json
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The plan touches 37 files (17 of them tests or docs) across more than 6 subsystems because a cost_events column alone spans drizzle/overdeck, src/lib, tests and docs, and the issue's three acceptance criteria (ledger + sessions.json, cost report by effort, Agents-row Playwright check) span src/lib, src/cli, packages/contracts and src/dashboard. The surfaces no stated acceptance criterion names (issue-view rows, ConversationList, Agents-page conversation entries) were split into PAN-4510; splitting further would move one of the operator's stated acceptance criteria out of this issue.

narratives.Problem: Effort is resolved, persisted and changeable (PAN-4249, PAN-4253-PAN-4255), but no cost-ledger row or sessions.json line records it, no cost report groups by it, and the Agents page, pan status and pan show do not show it. Nobody can see what a given effort level costs or which level an agent runs at.
narratives.Proposal: Record effort at launch on sessions.json lines (passed explicitly where the line is written before state.json); add a nullable cost_events.effort column persisted by every write door; stamp ingested rows with the claude record's observed effort, else the session's launch effort, else state.json effort for the newest session only; add getEffortRollup and `pan cost effort`; carry effort on native-agent DirectoryEntry values and render it on Agents History rows and the detail header; print it in pan status and pan show; document all of it. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4259.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Issue-view agent rows, ConversationList/ConversationRow, and Agents-page conversation entries (PAN-4510).
- A second effort display in the conversation header (the PAN-4255 composer chip already shows it).
- Effort on Live-view rows of the Agents page.
- Backfilling effort into existing cost_events or events.jsonl rows, or rewriting existing sessions.json lines.
- effortSource on sessions.json lines or cost rows.
- CostResolver.byEffort, a cost-by-effort HTTP route, or any dashboard costs UI change.
- Effort on background-AI, memory-extraction, or legacy-migration cost rows.
- src/cli/commands/strike.ts and its lint-effort.sh baseline row (PAN-4258).
- Any effort default, or any change to how effort is resolved or launched.
- Any new `effort ?? '<level>'` fallback or copied effort-level list.

autoDecisions.summary: Split issue-view rows, ConversationList rows, and Agents-page conversation entries into new sibling PAN-4510.
autoDecisions.rationale: The full S7 surface projects to about 40 files; those surfaces are named by none of PAN-4259's three acceptance criteria and share no data path with the ledger work, so splitting them keeps every stated criterion here.

autoDecisions.summary: A cost row's effort is the claude record's observed effort, else the sessions.json launch effort for its session, else state.json effort only for the newest session, else NULL.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rows are built at ingestion, not launch; the record value is what the request ran at, the session entry is the launch value, and state.json describes only the most recent launch.

autoDecisions.summary: sessions.json carries effort only, omitted when unknown.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names only effort; omitting the key keeps legacy and effort-less lines identical and avoids a fake 'unknown' level.

autoDecisions.summary: The effort report is getEffortRollup in cost-sync.ts plus `pan cost effort`, with no CostResolver method or HTTP route.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan cost already reads cost-sync raw SQL; one variant per operation, and a new route would need a no-loss-matrix row for no stated need.

autoDecisions.summary: No backfill of existing cost rows; they report as 'unrecorded'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Historical effort is not knowable reliably and requestId dedup never rewrites rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Agents page shows effort on History rows and the detail header, not Live rows.
autoDecisions.rationale: Live rows show no model or harness today; the detail header serves both views.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave strike.ts to PAN-4258 despite the lint baseline comment naming PAN-4259.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4258's issue body owns the strike dry-run effort line.

items.title: sessions.json entries record the launch effort

expected_outputs: session-index.test.ts passes including the new effort cases

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4259.md W1. In src/lib/session-history.ts: add effort?: EffortLevel to SessionIndexEntry and SessionEntryMetadata; normalizeSessionEntry keeps effort only when isEffortLevel; sessionIndexLine writes effort from metadata, else from state.json when isEffortLevel, and omits the key otherwise (never 'unknown'); add exported readLaunchEfforts(agentId) that reads sessions.json and state.json once and returns a lookup: the entry's effort, else state.json effort only for the newest indexed session (or any session when the index is empty), else undefined. Exact snippets are in the PRD.

items.title: Given appendSessionIdToHistory is called with metadata effort 'xhigh', when readSessionIndex reads the agent, then the new entry returns effort 'xhigh' and the raw line contains "effort":"xhigh".
Given state.json holds effort 'low' and the call passes no effort, the new line records effort 'low'; for an agent with no state.json the raw line has no effort key.
Given a hand-written legacy line without effort and a line with effort 'bogus', readSessionIndex parses both and returns effort undefined for each.

Given entries s1 (medium), s2 (none), s3 (none, newest) and state.json effort 'high', readLaunchEfforts returns medium for s1, undefined for s2, high for s3, and high for any id when the index is empty.

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4259.md W2. createFreshSessionIdentity(agentId, harness, model?, effort?) forwards effort in the append metadata. spawn.ts: pass options.effort to createFreshSessionIdentity in the fresh-spawn state literal (same line) and add effort: options.effort to the spawnRun appendSessionIdToHistory metadata. recovery.ts prepareRestartSessionIdentity: allocate(agentId, harness, state.model, state.effort). Both call sites run before state.json is saved, so the state.json fallback cannot supply the new effort.

items.title: Given no state.json exists, when createFreshSessionIdentity('a2', 'claude-code', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'max') runs, then readSessionIndex('a2') returns a newest entry with effort 'max'.

Given the change is applied, npm run lint:file-size exits 0 and src/lib/agents/spawn.ts is at or under 1081 lines.

items.title: Given a database whose cost_events table lacks effort, when it is reopened through getOverdeckDatabase, then PRAGMA table_info(cost_events) lists an effort column.

Add EffortRollup and getEffortRollup(issueId?) next to getModelRollup: GROUP BY effort, NULL or invalid values merge into one 'unrecorded' bucket, sort by EFFORT_LEVELS.indexOf with unrecorded last (no copied level list).
